poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaunsi lagi?
options: ⚖️ PM vs PTI: march hoga ya nahi?

https://www.reuters.com/business/samsung.what: Samsung ne Q3 operating profit ka andaza lagaya: 107.4 trillion won (~$80 billion) — pichle saal se takreeban 9 GUNA zyada. Wajah: AI chips ki demand mein tezi, memory chips ki qillat. Revenue bhi 127% barh ke 195 trillion won expected — musalsal chauthi record quarter.
https://www.reuters.com/business/samsung.why: AI infrastructure par itni investment ho rahi hai ke memory chips ki supply peeche reh gayi — aur jab demand supply se zyada ho, prices (aur profits) aasman par.
https://www.reuters.com/business/samsung.next: Q3 2027 tak ye qillat jari rehne ka andaza; detail results mah ke akhir mein ayenge.
https://www.reuters.com/business/samsung.take: 9 GUNA profit?! 💰 Samsung to ab chips nahi, sona bana raha hai. AI boom ki asal jeet hardware walon ki hai — software walay hype karte reh gaye, paisa memory mein hai.

https://www.morningstar.com/news/marketw.what: Google ne Constellation Energy ke sath deal ki — 11 maujooda reactors upgrade kar ke 890 MW nayi nuclear capacity online layega ($4.3 billion upgrades), plus 15 saal ka 2,700 MW ka alag agreement. Maqsad: AI data centers ko reliable bijli.
https://www.morningstar.com/news/marketw.why: AI data centers bijli ke bhookay hain — solar/wind kabhi up kabhi down, lekin nuclear 24/7 chalti hai. Big Tech ab apne liye bijli ghar khareed raha hai.
https://www.morningstar.com/news/marketw.next: Upgrades agle chand saalon mein mukammal honge; Constellation ke shares already upar.
https://www.morningstar.com/news/marketw.take: Google ab nuclear power plant khareed raha hai ⚛️😅. Matlab AI ko chalane ke liye bijli itni chahiye ke mulkon wali soch karni par rahi hai. Hum yahan load-shedding se lar rahe hain, wahan AI ke liye atom bomb wali bijli ban rahi hai.

https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/waym.what: Waymo (Alphabet ki robotaxi company) ne apna pehla debt raise $5 billion tak barha diya — shuru mein $3 billion ka target tha. PIMCO, Blackstone aur Sixth Street hissa le rahe hain. Paisa fleet barhane aur AI compute ke liye — Las Vegas, Detroit, Japan aur Singapore expansion par hai.
https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/waym.why: Robotaxi ab experiment nahi, scale ka khel hai — hazaron gariyan, har sheher mein. Aur $5 billion bhi shuruat hai: target hafte mein 10 lakh paid rides.
https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/waym.next: Naye sheheron mein launches agle mahino mein; driverless rides ki taadad barhegi.
https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/waym.take: Driverless taxi ke liye $5 BILLION ka qarz 🚕💸. Hum yahan Careem ke fare par lar rahe hain, wahan gari khud chal rahi hai. Robotaxi ka future aa gaya — bas hamare sheheron mein traffic ka kya banega, ye soch ke dar lagta hai.

https://runtimewire.com/article/nous-res.what: Nous Research ne $90 million Series B raise kiya — valuation $1.5 billion. Investors mein Nvidia, Microsoft ka M12, Samsung bhi. Paisa unke open-source Hermes AI agent (214,000+ GitHub stars) ke business tools aur mobile app par lagega.
https://runtimewire.com/article/nous-res.why: Open-source se community milti hai, lekin paisa enterprise customers se banta hai — ye round test karega ke GitHub stars dollar mein badalte hain ya nahi.
https://runtimewire.com/article/nous-res.next: Enterprise tools aur mobile app launch expected.
https://runtimewire.com/article/nous-res.take: 214,000 GitHub stars = $1.5 billion valuation 🤯. Open-source walon ne phir kamaal kar diya. Lekin asal test ab hai: free mein pasand karne wale, paise denge? Dekhte hain.

https://www.advanced-television.com/2026.what: WSJ Intelligence ki study (801 CEOs): companies ausatan 183 AI tools chala rahi hain, lekin 85% ke paas inhe jorne ka system nahi — 'orchestration gap'. Sirf 15% AI investments unified system ki tarah kaam kar rahe hain. Masla technology nahi, culture aur structure hai.
https://www.advanced-television.com/2026.why: Har department ne apna AI tool khareed liya, lekin koi malik nahi, data bikra hua hai — to faida khaak hoga.
https://www.advanced-television.com/2026.next: Companies ab consolidation aur governance ki taraf barhengi — tool kam, integration zyada.
https://www.advanced-television.com/2026.take: 183 AI tools, aur faida zero 😂. Matlab office mein har kisi ne AI khareed li, lekin use karna kisi ko nahi aaya. Technology ka masla nahi — management ka masla hai. Pehle apna ghar theek karo, phir AI lagao.

https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.what: Kal se (Oct 9) free Gemini users sirf (3.5) Flash-Lite use kar sakenge — (3.6) Flash aur (3.1) Pro ki access khatam. AI Plus ($4.99/month) walon se bhi Pro cheen liya gaya. AI Pro walon ko sab models + Deep Think reasoning milega.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.why: AI chalana mehnga hai — har free query par Google ka kharcha. Ab model access subscription tier se juri hai: jitna paisa, utna taqatwar model.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.next: Oct 9 se naye limits live; free users ko downgrade mehsoos hoga.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.take: Free ka zamana khatam 😤. Kal se Gemini free = halka model. Google keh raha hai: AI chahiye to jeb dheeli karo. AI ab utility bill ban raha hai — pehle muft tha, ab meter lagega.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2035316.what: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Oct 7 ko kaha ke PTI ke planned long march ko 'kisi bhi tareeqe se' roka jayega — opposition se protest khatam kar ke dialogue par wapas aane ki appeal. Kehna hai protests se economy, exports aur manufacturing ko nuqsan ho raha hai. PTI ke Gohar Ali Khan ka jawab: baat-cheet ab tak 'sirf offers' tak mehdood, koi positive qadam nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2035316.why: March ka matlab roads band, business band — aur IMF deal ke critical waqt mein political noise investors ko darata hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2035316.next: PTI march ki tareekh aur hukumat ke response par sab ki nazar.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2035316.take: Phir wahi khel: march ki dhamki, rokne ki dhamki ⚖️. Ek taraf 'dialogue karo', doosri taraf 'sirf offers'. Awam beech mein phansi — na economy chal rahi hai, na siyasat. Kabhi to dono taraf se koi aik faisla hoga?

https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.what: Bahrain ke Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani Oct 7-8 ke do-roza daure par Pakistan aaye — Ishaq Dar ki dawat par. Dono teesra Pakistan-Bahrain Joint Ministerial Commission session co-chair karenge: trade, investment, defence, security, labour aur culture par baat.
https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.why: Bahrain mein 150,000+ Pakistani rehte aur kaam karte hain — manpower aur remittances ke liye ye rishta ahem hai.
https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.next: Joint commission ke baad trade/investment agreements expected.
https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.take: Chhota mulk, bara rishta 🇧🇭🤝. 1.5 lakh Pakistani wahan kamate hain — ye daura unke liye bhi ahem hai. Gulf ke sath achay taluqaat = remittances ka flow. Quiet diplomacy, solid faida.

https://arynews.tv/ji-amir-says-pm-meeti.what: JI amir Hafiz Naeemur Rehman ne kaha hukumat ne rabta kiya hai aur do din mein PM se mulaqat expected hai. Mutalba: petroleum levy khatam ki jaye — dawa hai mahana ~Rs150 billion wasool hota hai, zyada tar ghareeb awam se. Relief na mila to Multan se march; Oct 9 ko Charsadda rally to hogi hi.
https://arynews.tv/ji-amir-says-pm-meeti.why: Petrol Rs394.83/litre par hai — levy awam ki jeb par seedha bojh. JI is mudde par awami pressure bana rahi hai.
https://arynews.tv/ji-amir-says-pm-meeti.next: PM mulaqat ke baad faisla — levy mein kami hui to bari khabar hogi.
https://arynews.tv/ji-amir-says-pm-meeti.take: Rs150 billion mahana levy?! ⛽😱 JI keh rahi hai ye tax ghareeb ki jeb se nikalta hai — aur petrol Rs400 ke qareeb hai. Agar hukumat ne levy ghata di to awam ko asal relief milega. Mulaqat ka intezar karo.

https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/7.what: 95 lakh se zyada logon ko subsidised petrol mil chuka — Rs100/litre discount, SMS token system se, bike/rickshaw/chhoti gari walon ke liye. Scheme ka kharcha mahana Rs35-40 billion. Lekin 800cc se bari gariyan, diesel vehicles aur public transport (Gallup ke mutabiq 79% Pakistani) bahar hain. IMF chahta hai relief 3 mahine tak mehdood ho aur BISP se diya jaye.
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/7.why: Relief acha hai lekin design mein khamiyan — jin ko sab se zyada zaroorat (public transport users), wo bahar.
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/7.next: IMF review mein scheme ka mustaqbil tay hoga.
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/7.take: Rs100 discount acha, lekin 79% awam bahar?! 🚌😕 Bike walon ko relief, bus walon ko kuch nahi — jabke bus mein safar karne wala ameer nahi hota. IMF bhi naraz. Scheme ki niyat achi, design adhoori.

https://a-sports.tv/new-look-pakistan-ge.what: Pakistan team ne Rawalpindi mein Oct 7 ko training ki — Sri Lanka ke khilaf 3-match T20I series Oct 9 se (matches Oct 9, 11, 13). Naye captain Sahibzada Farhan ki qayadat mein youth + experience ka mix; bowling coach Shaun Tait fast bowlers sambhal rahe hain. Sri Lanka 2019 ka 3-0 whitewash dohrana chahegi.
https://a-sports.tv/new-look-pakistan-ge.why: Nayi qayadat, naya combination — series team ki direction tay karegi.
https://a-sports.tv/new-look-pakistan-ge.next: Pehla T20I Oct 9 ko — jeet se confidence milega.
https://a-sports.tv/new-look-pakistan-ge.take: Naya captain, nayi team, purana badla? 🏏 Sri Lanka ne 2019 mein 3-0 kiya tha — ab hisaab barabar karne ka waqt. Sahibzada Farhan par sab ki nazar. Oct 9 ko dekhte hain kya hota hai!

https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.what: Punjab Traffic Police ne smog ke khilaf sakht action ka hukum — dhuwan chhorne wali gariyon par pabandi, EPA aur Transport Department ke sath joint checkpoints. Khuli rait/malba/bhoosa le jane wali gariyon par jurmana; lights aur reflective tapes lazmi. Overspeeding par bhi crackdown tez, fog areas mein heavy vehicles ki road parking par pabandi.
https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.why: Har saal smog Lahore ko duniya ke aalooda-tareen sheheron mein le aata hai — sardiyan qareeb, action pehle se.
https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/07-Oct-2.take: Smog season se pehle action — achi baat 🌫️🚫. Lekin har saal yehi elaan hota hai, phir November mein Lahore saans nahi le pata. Is baar amal bhi ho to baat bane. Dhuwan chhorne wali gari dekho to report karo!

mood: Aaj ka mood: Samsung ka 9x profit, Gemini par pabandi, aur Rawalpindi mein cricket ki tayyari 🚀😤🏏
